shortDescription: European Central Bank Governing Council member Yannis Stournaras said the ECB must be mindful of upside inflation risks but should not act hastily, according to Bloomberg.He said the central bank should remain vigilant.

title: GEOPOLITICS | ECB Should Stay Vigilant, Not Rush, Stournaras Says
